description: The file defines a Flutter widget for the Home screen of a task management app. It imports various custom screens, database, and widget files, and manages a list of custom lists fetched from a database, displaying them in a scrollable view with navigation to other parts of the app.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main home screen of the app, including app bar, actions, and a list of custom lists fetched from database.

classes.name: _HomeState
classes.description: The internal state class managing list data, loading state, and UI building logic for the Home widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes state and triggers data refresh from database.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches all notes (custom lists) from database and updates the state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the Home screen, including app bar, tiles, and dynamically generated list of custom lists.
